The Shapoorji Pallonji (SP) Group, helmed by Shapoorji Pallonji Mistry, represents the second-largest shareholder with an 18.37% equity interest. The remaining share capital of approximately 15.63% is held by various listed Tata operating companies (such as Tata Motors, Tata Chemicals, Tata Power, and Tata Steel, which collectively hold ~13%), alongside individual members of the Tata family. Functioning as the strategic apex of the group, Tata Sons directs long-term capital allocation, brand stewardship, and cross-sector investments across information technology, automotive, materials, aerospace, retail, and hospitality.
